title: ComicOcrDetectionSample
description:
One page and every region on it, for training and evaluating detection.

Distinct from ComicOcrTrainingPair, which is a CROP and its text and trains the reader. This is a PAGE and its regions, and trains the finder. Detection must come first: a transcriber cannot read a balloon nothing located, and a scene graph cannot relate panels nothing bounded.

The labels here are known BY CONSTRUCTION when `source` is `synthetic` -- the generator placed each region, so nothing inferred them and `confidence` does not apply. That is what lets detection training start before any human review exists: unlike the reader, the finder does not wait on an attested corpus.

source.description: `synthetic` labels are placed by the generator and are exact. `attested` labels came from a human through the iPub envelope and carry that provenance. `candidate` must never appear here -- a machine's own output is not a label for its successor.

panels.description: Drawn panel frames, in page pixels. A page may legitimately have none -- a borderless bleed page is a real layout, not a detection failure, so an empty array is a claim and not a gap.

regions.description: Every text region on the page, GROUPED as a reader groups them: one entry per utterance or inscription, never one per glyph. Japanese text yields one connected component per kana, so a detector that reports components reports fragments -- this schema's unit is the thing a person would read aloud as one.

enclosure_box.description: The footprint the drawn enclosure occupies, which is larger than the text box for a balloon. Kept separate because the detector sees the enclosure and the reader wants the text -- scoring the wrong one silently penalises a correct detection.

enclosure.description: What is drawn around the text. `none` is free text over the page, where sound effects and signage sit -- and is the case a frame-keyed detector cannot see at all.

panel.description: Index into `panels`, when the region falls inside one. Null is meaningful: a sound effect in the gutter belongs to a moment without sitting inside a frame.

text.description: Present for synthetic samples, where it is known by construction. Detection does not need it; carrying it means one generated page can serve both the finder and the reader.
